title: TTM Site Assurance Assessor
description: Six-module online course for experienced TTM practitioners moving into independent site assurance: the NZGTTM assurance processes, what national crash data says about who gets hurt, G1–G8 and Sela priority checks, site outcomes and Stop Work Orders, and writing findings that stand up. Completing it unlocks SELA-SAT-01 Using the Sela Site Assurance Tool (the Sela site assurance app with training, $150 + GST first year). Supervised field assessments for Sela endorsement are available on request.
